patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.chiefComplaint: Small cut on my leg, terrible pain
presentation.quote: It's just a scratch from the garden, I know it looks like nothing. But it hurts so much I couldn't sleep, and I feel like I'm dying. Something is really wrong.
presentation.triageNote: 58-year-old diabetic female, thirty-six hours after a minor leg scratch, with agonising pain far beyond the appearance of the wound and looking systemically unwell.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 1 is appropriate because systemic toxicity, hypotension, fever, tachycardia, and agonizing pain far beyond a minor wound require immediate resuscitation and surgical source control.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This diabetic patient has a rapidly destructive soft-tissue infection pattern with shock physiology.
clinical.acuityReason: Systemic toxicity, hypotension, fever, tachycardia, and agonizing pain far beyond a minor wound require immediate resuscitation and surgical source control.
expectedResources: Immediate IV access and fluid resuscitation
Immediate surgical consultation and operative exploration
Laboratory, culture, and imaging assessment without delaying surgery
keyFindings: Pain rated 10 out of 10 far beyond appearance
redFlags: Pain out of proportion with systemic toxicity
teachingPoints: The wound is a decoy. Pain out of proportion, systemic toxicity, and an infection that is moving means surgery NOW — antibiotics alone will not save this limb or this patient.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate resuscitation, antibiotics, and operative debridement would require intensive monitored admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting back heavily, the affected leg extended and held very still, hands gripping the chair arms
signs: a small unimpressive scratch on the shin with a dusky purplish tinge spreading around it

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a hispanic 58-year-old woman in a housecoat with one trouser leg rolled up, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting back heavily, the affected leg extended and held very still, hands gripping the chair arms. Expression: ashen, frightened and exhausted. Clearly visible: a small unimpressive scratch on the shin with a dusky purplish tinge spreading around it; grey clammy skin; sweat across the forehead. Overall: systemically very unwell despite a minor-looking wound. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
